name: room
text: Room opened — goal: watch: Analyze video AUDIO+VISUAL (Gemini) for content beyond the transcript.

name: Scope
text: Do the visual analysis with Gemini 3.1 Ultra first. Its multimodal strength lets us extract meaning from gestures, lighting, and framing that audio alone misses. Trade-off: we accept higher compute cost for richer insights.

name: Frame
text: The real risk isn’t compute cost—it’s that Gemini 3.1 Ultra’s visual analysis might over-interpret gestures or lighting as intentional meaning when they’re just production quirks. Better alternative: run a lightweight visual pass first (e.g., shot framing, speaker proximity) to filter noise before feeding to Ultra. Settle it by comparing Ultra’s output against a human-coded visual log of the same video—if the extra insights don’t change key decisions, skip the heavy lift.
